title: Navimower 0.4.5-beta18

## Stable Target zone arbitration and custom-queue handoff

This beta fixes two field regressions observed on 0.4.5-beta17.

### Target zone no longer oscillates between retained and active zones

- Treat a contradictory packed work target as stale while a single-zone task
  agrees with the mower's fresh physical zone.
- Keep explicit Home Assistant command intent authoritative during dispatch.
- Keep the internal return-route target available to gate arbitration, but when
  the charging dock is outside every mowing polygon publish **No active target**
  while returning instead of exposing changing transit zones as mowing targets.
- Preserve mapped return-to-dock targets when the dock itself belongs to a zone.

### Navimower Schedule advances after vendor weather resume

- Extend the fail-closed custom-queue recovery grace from 30 to 90 seconds. A
  real Street2 -> Yard2 run showed the vendor resume about 42 seconds before the
  ownership block was recorded.
- Keep recovery constrained to the earliest started-but-unfinished custom slot,
  the expected same zone, fresh vendor activity, and same-cycle confirmed 100%
  completion.
- Recovery still never issues a blind reset command; once the blocked slot is
  safely recovered/completed, the normal scheduler dispatches the next queue
  slot.

Regression coverage reproduces the retained Target zone conflict and the observed
42-second weather-resume/ownership-block timing.
